Outside of work, I am a hobbyist photographer, virtual pilot and an S1-rated air traffic controller with VATUSA - [VATSIM](https://www.vatsim.net){target="_blank"}'s United States division.

## Flight Simulation

I am a virtual Seattle ARTCC controller on VATSIM, and I enjoy being a part of such a wonderful community! Controlling virtual air traffic is a fun and challenging hobby which keeps me on my toes. I also fly (virtually).
